date: DRAFT, set to the day of the founder ruling
title: PRD chats run on Claude Managed Agents; the PRD tools are a platform MCP server
decision: Each PRD chat (main, section, NGO side chat) is one Claude Managed Agents session that an edge function starts and relays. The PRD tools are an MCP server hosted as an edge function: list_sections, read_section, stage_section, commit_turn, and the REQ-036 state tools. The agent stages the sections a turn affects and commits them together; a commit is refused as a whole when any staged section changed since the agent read it, and the tools run the role check, the Needs review cascade and the sources. Each session reaches the server with a signed token naming one chat and one project, with an expiry, held in a vault created for that session. The backend starts each turn (role check, money hold, user.message), relays the text to useChat, and settles each model request's priced tokens once per event id and the runtime once per turn. No repository is mounted for the PRD chats; repository and Linear writes stay with the planning package and the task-management writer (REQ-026). OpenRouter leaves the PRD path, and the wiring plan of 2026-10-14 is replaced.
evidence: loop/items/ai-path/memo.md and loop/items/ai-path/spike/. The founder: "I want the harness in the cloud to run the prd tools" (2026-10-23). Measured in the Supabase edge runtime against the local database: the PRD tools server refuses missing, forged and expired tokens; completes the MCP handshake and lists its tools; keeps staged sections invisible until commit_turn; refuses a stale commit as a whole and accepts the merged one; keeps one project's token out of another project. Also measured: the path-neutral money ledger and no model key in the browser stream. Read: Managed Agents MCP servers, vault static_bearer credentials injected by Anthropic's proxy, session usage, and the 400-second edge function limit. Not measured: Anthropic's MCP client against this server, model behaviour with the tools, cost and latency per turn.
open: A founder ruling on holding the platform's MCP token in an Anthropic vault; how the integration test tier reaches the MCP server (tunnel or stand-in harness); the Claude model for the PRD.
supersedes: The OpenRouter clause of d93, and the wiring plan's OpenRouter route recorded under d97.
